description: Changes a label: rename it (use "Parent/Child" to move it under another), recolor it, or choose whether it shows in the sidebar and in the message list. Only the fields you pass change. Colors must come from the Gmail palette, e.g. #fb4c2f red, #ffad47 orange, #16a766 green, #2da2bb teal, #4a86e8 blue, #a479e2 purple, #f691b3 pink, #666666 or #cccccc gray.

account.description: Email address or label of the account (see list_accounts).

background.description: Hex color from the Gmail palette

in_message_list.description: Show the label on messages in the list

sidebar.description: Sidebar visibility; unread = only when it has unread mail

name: update_label
